scope: Every circuit with a Formula One Grand Prix in the OpenF1 era (2023 onwards), so every entry has car-position data for its layout. Earlier circuits have no such source and are not included.

sources.name: Wikipedia: List of Formula One circuits
sources.note: Table states it is accurate as of the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix; lengths and turns are for the last configuration used in Formula One.

sources.name: Wikipedia circuit articles (infobox)
sources.note: Race lap record of the layout matching the Grand Prix length, Formula One class only; null otherwise.
